channel.title: Made in Dagenham
channel.desc: In 1968, two years prior to the Equal Pay Act, Rita O'Grady and 187 other women are slaving for a pittance at Ford's Dagenham manufacturing plant. Discontentment is stirring, and when the women's machinist jobs were reclassified as 'unskilled', union rep Albert Passingham persuades plucky Rita to take a stand.
